title: Quenched Juicy Argentinian Chicken Wings Bowl
description: This grassy, juicy, light dish is a twist on traditional argentinian flavors featuring succulent chicken wings served in a korean-brass-bowl.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400 degree fahrenheit. Prepare a baking sheet lined with parchment paper for cooking chicken wings.
Season chicken wings with a pinch of salt and a sprinkle of korean chili flakes. Place chicken wings on prepared baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While chicken wings are cooking, heat olive oil in a separate pan over medium-high heat. Pour in argentinian chimichurri and stir occasionally until sauce has reduced slightly.
Remove chicken wings from oven and toss with the reduced chimichurri sauce, honey and soy sauce if using.
In a separate pot, bring water to a boil and reduce to a simmer. Once boiling, add 1-2 tablespoons of sucrose to water and stir to dissolve.
Slowly add 1-2 cups of cornstarch slurry to the water mixture, whipping constantly with a wire whisk until mixture has thickened to your liking.
Once the cornstarch mixture has thickened, remove the sauce from heat and let cool.
Spherify the cooled sauce using a spherification kit or a siphon gun. Once spherified, transfer chicken wings to korean brass bowl and garnish with chopped cilantro and a few quenched sauce spheres.
Garnish additional chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
